prior_work.current_state: No finite cover is known. The accepted 307-tile chordal obstruction proves that every cover drawn from the pinned 313-tile pool must use at least one of the six omitted low-order primes 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, and 23. Generic full-pool min-conflicts and the pure root-confined parallel construction are both closed for the pinned pool. Exhaustive source-first qualification fixes an optimal six-tile hybrid seed with union density 1817/3168. The exact period-5040 stage covers 455423/635040 with its five compatible seed tiles fixed. The factor-complete period-55440 lift introduces prime 23 and 23 other tiles. A subsequent exact joint polish changes only prime 3361 from shift 1095 to 55, proves coverage exactly 467249711/614718720, and leaves 737,345,045 rooted holes; after fixing prime 5 at shift zero, no one-coordinate move among the other 54 tiles improves that assignment. The exact factor-two lift to period 110880 introduces five more tiles and removes 45,114,706 of the fourfold predecessor holes, leaving 2,904,265,474 rooted holes and coverage 38802103/50803200. Its shifts came from a disclosed sample search and are not claimed optimal. The next earned route is to compare this exact marginal reduction with the next compatible prime-factor lift. The frozen affine verifier remains the only positive cover gate.
